seo.title: Trip.com: TripGenie genAI assistant - AI-assisted order volume +400 percent (2026)
seo.meta_description: TripGenie, Trip.com's conversational assistant, pushes AI-assisted order volume up 400 percent in one year and cuts hotel-comparison clicks by 80 percent.
seo.resume_citable: In 2026, Trip.com reports that the volume of orders assisted by its conversational agent TripGenie grew about 400 percent in one year, with nearly 60 percent of interactions booking-related.

faq.a: Trip.com's conversational assistant, integrated into the app and the site, which helps plan, compare hotels, and book within the chat thread.
AI-assisted order volume up about 400 percent over one year, nearly 60 percent of interactions booking-related, and 80 percent fewer clicks on the hotel comparator.

pattern: genAI conversational assistant for planning and booking
objectif_business: Turn the conversational assistant into a booking channel in its own right, taking travelers from the open question (where to go, which hotel) through to payment without leaving the chat thread.
description: TripGenie is the conversational assistant integrated into the Trip.com app and site. The traveler asks a question in natural language, compares hotels, checks baggage or lounge rules, translates a menu, and can book within the conversation. It also accepts image uploads to start a search. In March 2026, Trip.com Group published a reading of three years of usage: interactions lean toward booking (nearly 60 percent), the hotel comparator shortens the journey, and usage differs by market, real-time decisions in Asia's short-haul markets, planning further ahead in Europe and North America.

resultats.metrique: Volume of orders assisted by TripGenie on Trip.com, year over year
Use of core tools (hotel comparator, menu, translation), year over year
Share of interactions that are booking-related
Clicks needed for the hotel comparator

niveau_preuve.justification: Official Trip.com Group release quantified on three years of usage, echoed consistently by the established travel press (Travel Daily News, Travolution).

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time on each conversation, with periodic re-analysis of usage logs to adjust the journeys.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Trip.com Group's AI product team, supported by the data teams and the market leads.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The intent expressed in the conversation, crossed with the live hotel/flight inventory. If the inventory or prices do not surface in real time, the answer loses its transactional value and the assistant becomes a plain answer engine again.

etapes.detail: The traveler writes or uploads an image; the assistant extracts the intent (destination, dates, baggage constraint, hotel comparison).
The assistant calls the internal hotel, flight, and attraction search engines to retrieve live availability and prices.
It presents compared options and reduces the number of clicks to the choice (hotel comparator).
The traveler confirms and pays without leaving the conversation; the order is recorded as an AI-assisted order.
The teams read the logs by market to spot the uses (real-time decision vs upstream planning) and adjust the features.

prerequis_data: product inventory accessible by API in real time
prerequis_orga: a unit to read usage by market
stack_possible: a RAG layer over the inventory
replication.premiere_etape: Expose the inventory and prices through a clean API, then connect an assistant on a narrow scope (hotel comparison) before widening.

playbook.action: Expose the inventory and prices through a clean, real-time API, a prerequisite for any transactional assistant.
Connect an assistant on a narrow scope (hotel comparison) rather than on the whole catalog.
playbook.livrable: A transactional conversational prototype on the pilot scope.

playbook.action: Integrate booking and payment into the conversation thread, without redirection.
playbook.livrable: A complete booking flow inside the chat.

playbook.action: Instrument usage: AI-assisted orders, 7-day revisit, clicks saved.
Read the logs by market and extend the features (image upload, translation) where usage justifies it.

replication.equipe: 1 AI product PM + 3-5 engineers (LLM/RAG, inventory backend) + 1 data analyst to read usage by market.

statut_vivant.note: A three-year usage study published in March 2026; the assistant remains available on the app and the site.

transposable_ue.note: The pattern (a conversational assistant connected to inventory and CRM) is transposable. In the EU, using session and history data for personalization requires a GDPR legal basis and clear information; user image uploads add a minimization and retention constraint.

stack_technique.detail: In-house conversational assistant integrated into the app and site: planning, hotel comparison, baggage/lounge rules, translation, booking, and payment in the thread.
Generative component with vision (image upload) and translation; Trip.com does not publicly name the model(s) used.
Inventory and prices queried live by the assistant, a condition of its transactional value.
